findings.desc: packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts:844 still tells users to run `npm run serve`, but the repo does not define that script and `lattice serve --help` only exposes `--dev` and `--port`. This leaves a user-facing fallback message that keeps the same stale command reference the story was meant to remove.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts fallback hint from npm run serve to lattice serve, verified by the final docs check and the corrected serve docs audit path.
